name: Camino Lituano Žemaitija
description_md:
Camino Lituano Zemaitija is a waymarked hiking route located in LT. The route spans a distance of 215.6 km within the national waymarked hiking network.

The journey involves 1715 m of ascent and 1782 m of descent. Walkers can expect about 59 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule for completion. The difficulty is hard, derived from distance and ascent. During the trip, the route passes Hill of Crosses within 100 m.
